invertColors.description: If this is set to true, then the direction for dynamic coloring will be reversed.

positiveTrendColor.description:
The color for the positive trend direction.
The default hexcode is equivalent to design token green-50

negativeTrendColor.description:
The color for the negative trend direction.
The default hexcode is equivalent to design token red-50
